Maria (CS): Quick check-in on Zenwave onboarding — we're seeing intermittent 300–600ms tail spikes on their sample traces. Thinking a proactive q8 quant canary plus prefix caching for hot prompts and routing latency-sensitive endpoints to ded-1. @Aj @Sam O
Aj (Infra): Can you paste sample seq lengths + typical payloads?
Maria (CS): Sure — most requests are 256 tokens or less, 95% under 180. example payloads attached in the ticket.
```
{ "avg_tokens": 120, "p95_tokens": 178, "top_prompts": ["summary", "qa"] }
```
Sam O (Onboard): Ok I can spin a 10% canary with fallback to their current model. Recommend toggling prefix_cache_ttl=300s and enabling routing tag `latency-sensitive` for critical API keys.
Taylor (Zenwave): We're comfortable with a 10% canary. Need a simple perf/quality report after 24h. Also confirm rollback plan.
Liam (PM): @infra-bot can you give an estimated cost delta and perf expectation for q8 swap?
infra-bot: Estimated delta: token cost -27.8%. On our test fleet median latency -> 95ms (from 110ms), p99 increases slightly to ~420ms on long seqs. Quality risk: low-medium (score drift predicted 2/5).
Aj (Infra): Command I'll run: `redwood rollout start --cust zenwave --model gptx-16b-q8 --percent 10 --fallback gptx-16b-fp16 --tags latency-sensitive`
Maria (CS): I'll run the eval suite on their QA set (300 prompts) and capture detokenized diffs. If metrics show >1% accuracy drop we'll auto-rollback.
Sam O (Onboard): Coordinating with Taylor for approval window. Suggest scheduling canary for TOM 10:00 PT and a short postmortem at +24h.
Taylor (Zenwave): :thumbsup: approved for TOM 10:00 PT. Please keep us in the loop in #zenwave-support.
infra-bot: Canary initiated — id c-987654321, started at 2410001800. Monitoring hooks enabled (latency, token-cost, qol-evals).
